violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed sausages (120F) in chafing dish on 4th floor.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Employee reheated item to 165F+ during inspection.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: observed employee cutting strawberries with bare hands.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. PIC corrected employee. Strawberries discarded.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed cut honeydew (48F) on counter; milk (50F), yogurt (44F) in 1 door flat on 4th floor.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Items placed in residential refrigerator to be cooled down to 41F or below within a remainder of 2 hours.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: observed 1 door flat on 4th floor at 48-50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC removed all TCS foods to alternate, working unit. Facility will discontinue use of unit until repair is made. KENSINGTON FALLS CHURCH, THE (Inspection Date: 06/03/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Pasteurized foods used; prohibited foods not offered

violations.title: Pasteurized Food & Prohibited Food in HSP
violations.observation: The following unpasteurized prepackaged juice or unpasteurized prepackaged beverages containing juice is offered for sale or service in a facility serving a highly susceptible population: observed ‘Lohr’s Orchard’ apple cider in walk in cooler. Item not identified to be pasteurized per label.
violations.corrective_action: In a food service establishment that serves a highly susceptible population (HSP) the following criteria applies to juice: 1) children in schools, day care settings, or similar facilities are included as HSP, 2) prepackaged juice or a prepackaged beverage containing juice that have not been specifically processed to prevent, reduce, or eliminate the presence of pathogens, or a packaged juice or beverage containing juice that bears a warning label may NOT be served or offered for sale, and 3) unpackaged juice that is prepared on the premises for service or sale in a ready-to-eat form shall be processed under a HACCP plan. EHS discussed prohibition of unpasteurized items in any HSP facility. PIC discarded apple cider.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Observed fruit flies near hand sink on 3rd floor food service area.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. Please obtain pest control service to treat for fruit flies. EHS will follow up with 10 days.
